extraction.text:
K PRADEEP

Team Lead - Product Owner/Senior Business Analyst

Address Chennai, TN 600094

Phone +919176120261

E-mail p703468@gmail.com

LinkedIn www.linkedin.com/in/pradeep-kumar- 02779b10b

Experienced professional with over 10+ years in the Banking domain and 7+ years in IT as a Senior Business Analyst/Product Owner, specializing in Retail Banking and E-Channels. Demonstrated expertise in Digital solutions including Banking, Capital Markets, NBFC, and Ship Management.

Expertise in preparation of BRD, FRD/FSD and user stories. Adept in driving end-to-end Business Analysis Lifecycle, from business case preparation and requirement elicitation to functional design, feasibility alignment, API integration, and stakeholder alignment. Proven ability to collaborate with cross- functional teams including Product Managers, Technical Architects, QA, and Operations to deliver scalable and regulatory-compliant financial solutions.

Work History

2025-08 - Current	Team Lead II - Product Owner

Mastek, Chennai, India

Collaborated with stakeholders from Capital Markets, Wealth Advisory, and Compliance to define and prioritize product features, aligning with business goals and regulatory requirements (e.g., KYC, suitability, data privacy).

Exposure to client onboarding, portfolio analysis, goal-based investing, and

document security modules. Expertise in the preparation of BRD, FRD/FSD, and user stories.

Partnered with UX and engineering teams to deliver intuitive dashboards that

provided consolidated portfolio insights, performance analytics, and goal progress tracking.

Translated complex business requirements into user stories, acceptance

criteria, and process flows for agile delivery teams.

Oversaw API integrations with custodians, CRM, and trading platforms to enable real-time account data synchronization and transaction updates.

Worked closely with QA teams to define UAT scenarios, validate business logic, and ensure the delivery of high-quality releases.

2024-05 - 2025-08	Senior Business Analyst/Product Owner

ThinkPalm Technologies Pvt Ltd, Chennai, India

Facilitated PI Planning under the SAFe Agile framework, aligning product features and delivery milestones with program-level OKRs and ART commitments.

Maintained stakeholder alignment through regular demos, roadmap

presentations, and agile reporting, improving trust and engagement with senior leadership.



Collaborated closely with Data Architects and Developers; utilized SQL to perform data analysis, validate business requirements, troubleshoot data issues, align feasibility of proposed solutions, support API integration efforts, prepare documentation such as BRD and FRD, and derive actionable insights to support effective decision-making.

Drove agile ceremonies including sprint reviews, retrospectives, and daily standups to foster transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Proficient in leveraging tools such as JIRA, Miro, Draw.io, Cursor, and Microsoft Visio to effectively gather requirements, map processes, create visual workflows, and enhance cross-functional collaboration.

Led cross-domain platform modernization efforts, managing the replacement of legacy systems with scalable, modular digital solutions.

Owned product lifecycle management for ship management ERP modules, ensuring usability, integration, and compliance with maritime industry standards.

Introduced structured acceptance criteria using BDD (Behavior-Driven

Development) practices to improve testability and business traceability of user stories.

2023-06 - 2024-03	Lead Analyst(Business Analyst/Product Manager)

Gopik Connect Pvt.Ltd, Chennai, India

Owned and prioritized product backlog across cross-functional teams, ensuring optimal alignment with business goals and technical capabilities in banking and NBFC systems, while preparing documentation such as BRD and FRD to support requirement clarity and development.

Guided teams and refined Agile techniques throughout journey and

evolution of delivery cycles, establishing documentation framework to support Agile methodology implementation with Waterfall-centric delivery team.

Collaborated closely with IT teams, solution architects, and QA to translate

business needs into technical specifications, align feasibility of proposed solutions, and ensure delivery accuracy, including support for API integration using QR code functionalities.

Worked in banking and financial systems such as CMS, LMS and LOS.

Managed API integration and testing.

Oversaw the end-to-end implementation of Digital lending solutions, aligning them with client goals and reducing manual intervention by 30%.

Reviewed test plans and use cases to verify compliance with established business requirements.

Led backlog grooming sessions and sprint planning with cross-functional agile teams, ensuring timely delivery of high-value features and technical enhancements.

2021-11 - 2023-01	Assistant Manager(Business Analyst/Product Owner)

CAMS, Chennai, TamilNadu

Led requirement gathering and analysis for Virtual Accounts modules, enhancing real-time KYC and centralized control.



Facilitated Business Case Analysis for digitization of Centralized KYC processes, contributing to a 25% reduction in manual processing time.

Collaborated with QA and development teams to define test cases, align feasibility of third-party vendor service usage, and validate key business scenarios through SIT/UAT phases, including API integration to enable third- party services.

Accurately determine, assign, track and manage project tasks and Change

Requests, prepare documentation such as BRD and FRD, and capture details for Sprint Retrospectives and Backlog refinement as per internal standards.

Supported go-live and post-release activities, including UAT sign-off, user

training, and issue triaging for internal stakeholders and external clients.

2018-11 - 2021-05	Senior Analyst(Business Analyst)

Royal Bank Of Scotland, Chennai, TamilNadu

Played a pivotal role in stakeholder management, coordinating with business, technology, and operations teams to deliver seamless banking solutions.

Designed and implemented workflow automation solutions for mortgage

application intake, underwriting, and approval stages, aligning feasibility and enabling API integration to use various third-party vendor services, while ensuring regulatory compliance and enhanced customer experience.

Led requirement gathering and stakeholder workshops to digitize mortgage

origination and servicing processes, reducing manual intervention and improving turnaround time by 30%.

Performed internal system acceptance to deliver well-tested enhancements

and meet business requirements

Worked with CMS, LMS and LOS. Performed API integration and testing.

Met with clients to understand business requirements, perform gap analysis, create BPMN flowcharts, prepare BRD/FRD, and translate them into technical requirements.

2017-08 - 2018-09	Executive

CITI BANK INDIA, Chennai, TamilNadu

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements for credit, debit, and prepaid card issuance workflows, ensuring alignment with business goals and regulatory standards (e.g., PCI DSS, EMV).

Conducted gap analysis and process mapping for existing card issuance

systems, identifying automation opportunities and reducing issuance turnaround time by 25%.

Partnered with product, operations, and IT teams to streamline end-to-end

card lifecycle processes including application, approval, personalization, dispatch, and activation.

Supported the implementation and integration of card management

systems (CMS) and third-party vendors (e.g., personalization bureaus, card embossing services).

Defined and validated functional requirements, created user stories and test

cases, and facilitated UAT to ensure seamless customer onboarding and improved cardholder experience.



2015-03 - 2017-06	Senior Customer Service Executive

Intelenet Global Services, Chennai, TamilNadu

Created debt analysis and comparison reports contrasting different debt products, including various conventional and government-backed financing options.

Oversaw quality control of tax credit financial models, including

management of models involving underwriting integrity and project budgets.

Assisted senior executives with final loan closings and underwriting, coordination and submission of high-profile loan conversion packages.

Education

2014-08	Bachelor of Engineering: Electrical, Electronics And Communications Engineering

Loyola Institute Of Technology - Chennai

Skills

Effective communication Proficient in SQL for data analysis Problem-solving expertise

Skilled in project and product coordination Requirements analysis

Proficient in AI tools

Agile project management

Accomplishments

Documented and resolved performance issues of employees which led to 45% increase in efficiency of the unit.

Supervised 5 teams of 25+ staff members.

Resolved product issue through consumer testing.

Implemented AI-driven analytics tools, resulting in a 30% reduction in time spent on manual data processing and significantly improving the accuracy of predictive business insights.

Languages

Certifications

English, Tamil and Hindi.

Advanced

2025-04 CSPO® 2025-04 CSM® 2025-08 Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt 2022-12 PMP® 2024-03 SAFe® 6 Agilist 2025-03 Google Project Management Professional® 2025-05 5S Auditor 2025-06 Lean Champion

needs_review.text: Experienced professional with over 10+ years in the Banking domain and 7+ years in IT as a Senior Business Analyst/Product Owner, specializing in Retail Banking and E-Channels. Demonstrated expertise in Digital solutions including Banking, Capital Markets, NBFC, and Ship Management.

Expertise in preparation of BRD, FRD/FSD and user stories. Adept in driving end-to-end Business Analysis Lifecycle, from business case preparation and requirement elicitation to functional design, feasibility alignment, API integration, and stakeholder alignment. Proven ability to collaborate with cross- functional teams including Product Managers, Technical Architects, QA, and Operations to deliver scalable and regulatory-compliant financial solutions.
